Q2.requirement: Read-only market quotes from existing MT5 connection; no login, new account, orders, fills, or personal account export.

Q3.requirement: All eight application safety flags false; automatic trading disabled at terminal and program levels.

Q4.requirement: Preserve exact requested and received times, source/server/account class, all ticks including same-millisecond rows and bid/ask.
Q4.scope: All returned rows retained in the four successful one-attempt probes; future retries retain selected attempt only.

Q5.requirement: Verify ordering, valid sides, ranges, gaps and partial/synchronization errors; never infer full broker retention from count.

Q6.requirement: Raw source, source-code hash, artifact hashes and independent recomputation of quote statistics.

Q7.requirement: Bounded prospective public quote capture separate from broker-specific quotes, with exclusive lock and safe resume.

Q8.requirement: Run meaningful tests and actual available data capture; mark unavailable platform paths NOT TESTED.
Q8.scope: Actual local Wine/MQL5 and public capture; Windows Python path tested with fake backend only.

Q9.requirement: Keep historical cost schedule, execution and profitability gates unverified unless evidence actually supplies them.

Q10.requirement: Do not restart closed campaign/replay, tune sealed final or revive paused heartbeat.
